extracted.name: Arugula Beet Salad
extracted.description: This arugula beet salad is made with tender roasted beets and walnuts tossed with an easy vinaigrette for a colorful, crunchy salad that happens to be vegan.
ingredient_lines: 3 large beets, peeled and cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Mix beets, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon black pepper together on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven until beets are tender, about 40 minutes.
Mix roasted beets, arugula, walnuts, balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon pepper together in a bowl until well combined.
